page_title: UNI 1-2 WOL | Union Berlin v Wolfsburg 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' Surely that's handball by one of the Wolfsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+3' Dieter Hecking has decided to make a change. Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) replaces Dzenan Pejcinovic.
90+3' Substitution. Aaron Zehnter makes way for Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg).
90+3' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
90+3' The ball is out of play. Union Berlin win a corner kick.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Here comes a substitution. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Christopher Trimmel.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch for Rani Khedira.
86' That's the end of the game for Christian Eriksen, who is replaced by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg).
85' 1 - 2 Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) finds the back of the net with a precise, technical shot into the bottom right corner. A brilliant individual effort.
84' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
82' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
80' CLOSE! Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
80' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
78' The foul by Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Badstubner.
78' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Substitution. Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) on for Aljoscha Kemlein.
73' Florian Badstubner has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg).
72' Now Union Berlin have a corner.
71' Dieter Hecking is forced to make a change. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is unable to continue due to injury, Yannick Gerhardt comes on.
71' Dieter Hecking has decided to substitute Mohamed Amoura and he is replaced by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ilyas Ansah will be replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
68' It will be a substitution. Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Tom Rothe walks off.
67' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
64' The ball possession is 47:53.
61' Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. Union Berlin are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
58' Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
58' Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
57' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post!
53' The linesman signals a throw-in for Union Berlin.
51' Union Berlin force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
50' That was close by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
50' A player from Wolfsburg commits a rough challenge. Florian Badstubner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Union Berlin are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
48' Wolfsburg hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

46' 0 - 2 Goal! Christian Eriksen plays a long ball to Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the right of the goal. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 0:2.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Florian Badstubner has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Union Berlin have a corner.
40' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Union Berlin get a free kick.
39' A corner kick by Wolfsburg is thwarted by the well prepared Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin).
39' Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Frederik Ronnow has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
38' Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
35' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) picks up an injury.
33' What a chance that is! Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
32' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
30' Union Berlin are seeing far more of the ball now.
28' Wolfsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
27' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
26' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:2.
24' A pass from Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by Frederik Ronnow and the move breaks down.
22' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

20' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) tries to get on the end of a cross in a crowded box, but under pressure his header from near the penalty spot slips well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.

19' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Frederik Ronnow makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
18' Florian Badstubner interrupts the game. One of the players from Union Berlin won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

15' A neat pass is well received by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
14' One of the Wolfsburg players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Joakim Maehle plays a short, square pass into the path of Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg), who bends a shot straight into the top left corner to make it 0:1. Fabulous goal!
10' Wolfsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
8' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is about to take a corner kick.
6' The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will take a throw-in.
4' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
3' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
1' The match has just started.
Wolfsburg will kick the game off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
